statement: After scrutiny began, Semi-Tech Leasing refiled the same credit-registry documents with hardware descriptions, supplier names and server model numbers removed, while Nvidia said it is looking into the report and will work with its server-maker customer to investigate.
why: Scrubbing identifying hardware detail from public credit filings makes diversion harder to detect from the outside, so published China exposure understates the real figure and the vendor faces an open compliance investigation.

impact.mechanism: Less transparent paperwork around restricted-part financing raises the chance of new licence conditions, end-use audits and partner restrictions that constrain where the vendor's top accelerators may be sold.
